newsitem.title: CANADA: Phoenix Canada to bid for Box.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Canada to bid for Box.

text.p: Phoenix Canada Oil Co said on Tuesday it plans to make a formal offer to buy all the outstanding shares of Box Energy Corp.
Phoenix said it will bid US$12 for each class A voting share of Box and US$11.40 for each class B non-voting share.

Holders can opt for cash or a combination of cash and securities of an equal total value, at the discretion of both Phoenix and Box Energy shareholders. Box Energy has about 20.8 million shares of which 3.25 million are class A and the remainder class B. The bid, which is subject to certain conditions including regulatory approval, expires January 10.
